summary: Cloud Healthcare API introduces preview support for configuring DICOM blob storage settings, including storage class selection for import and storage and storage class changes.
extended_definition: Cloud Healthcare API introduces preview support for configuring DICOM blob storage settings, including storage class selection for import and storage and storage class changes.
